segments.text: Thanks for waiting. I have looked at your blood test results.
Start atorvastatin 20 mg at night, for your cholesterol.
Keep taking your amlodipine 5 mg once daily as before.
Try to take the new one at the same time each evening.
If you notice dark urine or bad muscle weakness, stop it and ring us.
Come back for a blood test in 3 months.
